comments.content: The version example is stale while the same line says only the latest 0.x release is supported. This can lead reporters to provide or assume an unsupported old version; use a current example or a generic placeholder that won't become inaccurate.
comments.existing_code: - Version [e.g. v0.5.1] (Note only the latest 0.x version is supported)
comments.suggestion_code: - Version [e.g. v0.5.x] (Note only the latest 0.x version is supported)
comments.thinking: Cargo.toml reports the current package version as 0.5.17, so v0.5.1 is an outdated example adjacent to a latest-version support policy.
